root_idea.summary: The root centers on a mark, sign, or distinguishing indication, and extends to something imposed as a condition or leaving a recognizable trace.
root_idea.development: From marking and signifying arise signs of events, stipulated conditions, physical cuts or traces, and the preparation or designation of people and goods for a consequential purpose.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic plural is presented under the supported singular dictionary citation form شَرَطٌ, with the attested plural أَشْرَاطُها retained in the usage description.

senses.definition: A sign, indication, or portent; in أَشْرَاطُ السَّاعَةِ, a sign heralding the Hour or Resurrection.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is the plural أَشْرَاطُها. The expression denotes indications of the Hour and, in some explanations, the preliminary events or means associated with its approach rather than the event itself.

senses.definition: A beginning or preliminary manifestation of an event.
senses.usage_conditions: This is an alternative lexical interpretation of أَشْرَاطُ السَّاعَةِ, understood as the initial developments or beginnings preceding the Hour.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To impose a condition, term, or stipulation on someone; to make an obligation binding, especially in a sale.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَيْهِ and in agreements and transactions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To scarify, slit, or make a cut; also to split palm leaves and twist them together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a cupper’s scarification, slitting an animal’s ear, and cutting palm leaves for plaiting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fall into a momentous or formidable situation.
To stipulate mutually or make conditions with one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes reciprocal agreement in which each party stipulates with the other.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mark or prepare oneself for an affair; to offer oneself and one’s property for it, especially when exposing oneself to death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be the self alone or the self together with property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set apart and prepare camels, sheep, or goats for sale, and make that intention known.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applies to a portion of livestock designated for sale.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prepare someone for a work or agency and place him in charge of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction can designate a person for a specified employment or responsibility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten a messenger to someone or send him forward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Connected lexically with the notion of something sent ahead or made an initial sign.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat something as of little account and risk, hazard, or imperil it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is expressed by a pronoun in the cited construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perform work well, exactly, and skilfully while constraining oneself to observe imposed conditions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Combines careful performance with adherence to stipulated requirements.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be made conditional or stipulated; to be singled out as conditionally intended.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive or impersonal construction concerning a condition attached to a saying or matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become bad or deteriorated after having been in a good state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited subject is camels or comparable livestock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A condition, term, stipulation, or requirement imposed on a person or matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in sales and analogous agreements, and also for requirements governing the valid application of a term or category.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two banks of a river.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the dual expression شَرْطَا نَهْرٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Roads leading in different directions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural usage distinct from the sense of contractual conditions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two stars forming the horns of Aries, the first lunar mansion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The associated plural أَشْرَاطٌ may refer to the asterism when the stars are treated as one group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The refuse, inferior kind, or lowest class of livestock or people; especially inferior or young camels and goats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can be used as singular or plural and with masculine or feminine reference; it may also describe livestock brought from one place to another for sale.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The noble, eminent, or honourable sort of people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a contrarily opposed usage to أَشْرَاطٌ meaning the refuse or lowest sort.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small watercourse flowing from relatively level ground into larger channels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a minor runnel or stream formed by runoff.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single act of scarifying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal designation of one scarification or cut.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing that one has made a condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for the stipulated item itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chosen or forward body of troops; later, a body of armed attendants, guards, or police, and a member of such a body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is associated with troops prepared for danger or distinguished by identifying marks, and with the police or armed attendants of an authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The best, choicest, or selected part of anything.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general extension from the notion of a selected group or portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relating to al-Sharaṭān or al-Ashrāṭ, the asterism of the two stars of Aries.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also occurs in a form derived from the plural because the stars are treated as one group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rope, cord, or flat plait made by twisting or weaving palm leaves, fibres, wool, silk, or gold thread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is connected with the splitting and twisting of the constituent leaves or fibres.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small receptacle or case for perfumes, utensils, or personal equipment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the receptacle called عَتِيدَة and the container called عَيْبَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel with a slit ear, or a sheep or goat subjected to a slight throat scarification.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The latter refers to an archaic practice regarded as a form of slaughter, though its validity was rejected in reported tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tall and slender or spare of flesh; also swift when applied to a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to men and to male or female camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The vilest or lowest sort of possessions, especially the lowest class of livestock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the expression الغَنَمُ أَشْرَطُ المَالِ, sheep or goats being described as the meanest livestock one possesses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lancet or other instrument used by a cupper for scarifying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also has the variant مِشْرَاطٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The equipment or preparations taken for an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In أَخَذَ لِلْأَمْرِ مَشَارِيطَهُ, the expression means taking the necessary apparatus or preparing oneself for the matter.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The clear asterism meaning is represented; alternative poem interpretations are treated as disputed contextual readings.

cautions: The Quranic form is the plural أَشْرَاطُها, normalized here under the singular citation form شَرَطٌ.
The reading of أَشْرَاطُ السَّاعَةِ as initial events or beginnings is an alternative lexical interpretation alongside the primary sense of signs or portents.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: A Lane discussion of a poetic occurrence of الأَشْرَاط records disputed interpretations as guards or watchmen and as low-status people, while preferring the asterism interpretation. These alternatives are not treated as an independent stable meaning of the Quranic occurrence.
